notes: Right-click a case in the library. A case type: Edit…, Add One to the Truck, Add All, Show / Hide Each Case, What's Inside…. One of its cases (350, 360…): What's in it…, Add It to the Truck or Find It in the Truck (or Go to the truck it's in), Edit the type (every one). Double-click still edits. Half-sheet labels: six to a page. Print Pack Labels on Half Sheets… now puts three labels side by side on each half-sheet sticker (six to a page, 2⅚" × 5½" each, cut apart on the dashed lines), instead of one big label per half.
